SG Motor Trachenberge is a German sports club, primarily known for its football (soccer) team. The club is based in Dresden, the capital city of the federal state of Saxony in Germany. SG Motor Trachenberge has a history linked to the industrial sports clubs tradition in East Germany, often associated historically with local factories or industries, reflecting the "Motor" designation common in such clubs.

The club has participated mostly in the lower tiers of the German football league system, primarily competing in regional and district leagues rather than at national professional levels. Over the years, SG Motor Trachenberge has served as a community club focused on local player development and grassroots sports initiatives.

Besides football, the club may also offer other recreational and sports activities, fostering sports participation among youth and adults in the Trachenberge district of Dresden.
